_readme: Every stock, generated or AI sample asset on the site, with its source and licence. The /credits page is built from this file. Add a row whenever you add an asset.

assets.note: Stock stand-in for the Passport hero until Passport's own Instagram clips arrive. Recut into 8 shots and colour graded.
